name: wp-monitor
description: Build and deploy tasks. Deploys go over rsync+ssh to the host alias in config.host (an ~/.ssh/config entry).

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.sync:backend: rsync -rlptz --delete --relative --itemize-changes -e 'ssh -o BatchMode=yes' htdocs/./api htdocs/./cron htdocs/./vendor htdocs/./database/migrations htdocs/./composer.json htdocs/./composer.lock htdocs/./index.php htdocs/./.htaccess "$npm_package_config_host:$npm_package_config_root/"
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm run build:frontend && npm run sync:frontend
scripts.deploy:backend: npm run build:backend && npm run sync:backend
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:backend && npm run deploy:frontend
scripts.deploy:check: npm run build && npm run sync:backend -- --dry-run && npm run sync:frontend -- --dry-run
